evidence: Matches the 'TX fees and policy' maintainer label and modifies core fee rate calculations in CFeeRate.
rationale: Fixes a potential division-by-zero crash in CFeeRate::GetFeePerK() and CFeeRate::operator+= when an instance has zero size. As stated in the description, evaluating EvaluateFeeDown(1000) on a zero-size rate divided by zero and crashed; fixing this provides a clear stability benefit, though there is no evidence it is triggerable remotely in production.
